bio: The owner-chef is captivated by the subtleties of charcoal cooking. By varying the placement of the charcoal, the distance between the fire and the ingredients, and the way the heat is controlled, he draws out a wide range of flavours. Charcoal, a pure form of carbon, gives off no moisture of its own, so gauging the moisture level of each ingredient as it cooks is no simple task. Additional dishes are interspersed throughout the course, bringing contrast and rhythm to the progression. Through flexibility and constant ingenuity, he pursues a cuisine that is distinctly his own.
